scope: Read-only source/private-ROM audit; no simulations, Docker actions, network downloads, maintained-source or donor writes.

fifo_contract.required_tail: RX supplies zero padding and TX discards padding, up to 3 bytes after the exact host length. Do not classify this original-driver padding as an invalid FIFO access.

metadata_vectors.other_layouts: No additional local vector verifies them. Preserve opaque identities in inspect/export; do not invent capacity.

source_findings.status: Proven by source; isolated wire-level regression delegated.
source_findings.effect: CMD24/25 checks only CSD capacity. A valid CRC returns an accepted token; beyond actual nblk, no HPS write occurs, yet busy ends successfully. The CMD25 next-block bound also checks only CSD capacity.
source_findings.fix: Check the actual backing end as well as CSD capacity for initial and next writes. Treat !w_in_file as an error, never successful programming. Preserve zero-filled read tails.

source_findings.effect: Only the 8 magic bytes are checked. Version byte 8 is ignored; the footer is then stripped and its identity fields are parsed as version 1.
source_findings.test: Valid magic with an unknown version must not be accepted as version 1. Use an explicit error or opaque handling.

source_findings.effect: A raw image of 1–3 sectors advertises a minimum of 4 sectors, contrary to the rounded-down comment. This provides a small EOF regression fixture.

source_findings.status: Proven by source; impact needs a focused peer test.
source_findings.effect: Any CMD16 response updates cached blocklen, even with an R1 error or response CRC failure. A subsequent transfer with length 0 can therefore use the rejected length.

source_findings.status: Integration hazard; no executed failure is claimed.
source_findings.effect: Mount resets the card and loader but not an owned HPS transfer. Reset drops HPS state. Adapt the drain and generation policy before supporting writable hot replacement.
Response CRC is checked, but the response end bit, header and index are not validated. Add malformed-response injection tests.

physical_boundary.D550: TMS320DA250GHH-144 separate audio DSP, with MMC/USB and AMA-WD2_BUS(4:0).
physical_boundary.X553: MMC connector connected through the audio-DSP/card interface and support circuitry.
physical_boundary.rule: Direct pins from the UPP MMIO host to the card are a transaction-level shortcut for NEM-4, not verified physical routing. Keep the ADSP module and missing AMA behavior visible.

rom_provenance.profile: NEM-4 4.03 service-file assembly, core portion of VA-linear flash backing; not the stock THC dump. The separate extension.bin is not included in this input.
rom_provenance.assembly_description: MCU nem440.3c1 plus PPM nem440.326 overlays, flash banks mapped into VA-linear order, unwritten holes filled FF, per-device hole 0x12c..0x164 left erased; core is the first 0x11c0000 bytes of the 0x13f0000-byte assembled backing.

stock_identical_audit_interval.covers: All IRQ table, DMA type-table and EPBUS instruction/name excerpts used in this P3 audit.

rom_provenance.conclusion: The whole-file hashes describe different profiles, while the audited original instruction and table bytes are identical to the stock dump. No simulation or firmware rebuild was performed.
